reviews.text: Thank you. This app means everything to me. Started my yoga practice and I’m finally moving my body in a way that feels good
100/10. The Underbelly yoga is everything! Inclusivity, positivity, joyful movement, relaxation. We love you Jessamyn!

In loooove 💕. I’ve always struggled with sticking to a movement routine and underbelly has been such a gift! It’s not at all pretentious, meets you where you are, and has so many options for classes. I’m a subscriber for life. 💕

Inclusive, self compassionate and accessible. The Underbelly has been a life-changer for me. I needed to better honor and care for myself and was seeking a movement practice to incorporate into my routine. This app has exceeded my expectations. 

The yoga and mindfulness videos are easy to approach, Jessamyn is a thoughtful, funny and bada** guide, and I love spending time with her in The Underbelly. The yoga practice relieves daily aches and pains, nourishes my spirit, and connects me to my body in a way that supports my mental health. 

Jessamyn Stanley and The Underbelly have had a far reaching impact on my overall wellness. I tell everybody who will listen.
Longtime subscriber. The underbelly is an affirming, supportive, grounding resource! Over my years subscribing jessamyn has taught me so much about moving and caring for my body. Highly recommend.

Love!. I love how inclusive this app is. I actually enjoy yoga more. I do however wish I was able to heart videos or create my own playlist of videos. There is the library option, which is great, it doesn’t offer the ability to create your own playlist.

I actually have a regular yoga practice now. Having access to the Underbelly and Jessamyn’s respectful and inclusive instruction has helped me connect with yoga as a physical and spiritual practice in my day to day life.
Download this!. Best yoga ever! Nonjudgmental and fun. I can’t imagine not doing yoga this way.
Amazing. This is wonderful. She’s such a beautiful soul. And the session are beautiful.
Yes!. Lots of video options at different levels.
fantastic app setup. fantastic body of work

Inclusive yoga. I like the underbelly. I have been loving that the guide has a tummy and talks about ways to accommodate your body in all the poses. I like her laid back vibe. I am doing these classes in my living room with my little dog joining in and so are they. I’ve been doing yoga for a few years and these classes are for all
Levels, all bodies and for all times of the day. Try this out!

Get it!. The crew at UB are amazing. A true gift to a life of modality and freedom. I’m a non-traditional body type for this movement and love the way I feel free to be me and move in the space that Jessamyn has created. 
Thank you 
Thank you 
Thank you!
Makes me LOVE yoga. I’ve done classes and other online yoga experiences… this app makes me look forward to yoga!
Absolutely amazing. As someone who taught yoga for 6 years, let me tell you, this is real yoga.

Finally, yoga for ALL bodies. Love this app and Jessamyn. You can get a good workout or just take some time to move your body. It’s nice to have an instructor who understands what it’s like being in a larger body and how to work with it. She’s also strong and inspiring.

Love this app!. Jessamyn is the best, and I love the range of options available on the app. Whether I have 5, 10, 20, or 40 minutes to practice, there’s something to help ground or refresh me and bring me back to myself.
The best. Motivating, inclusive, accessible and fun! Jessamyn makes yoga work your bod and your mind.

Jessamyn has changed me forever. It's a long journey to feel comfortable and present in your body. I'm not there. But I'm moving down the path thanks to Jessamyn. A guide on how to do yoga in my body. A guide who knows that fat bodies don't fold together in the same way that thin bodies do. A guide that doesn't limit me, my practice or my potential.

Jessamyn is amazing!. I like yoga but always feel intimidated by the perfect body instructors who make me feel like I should know exactly what to do and love every minute of it. Just as I am about to quit in these videos Jessamyn says she knows I am swearing at her, but to keep going. I often do find myself yelling at her, but I don’t give up often and love her style. She is knowledgeable, but realistic and funny. If you are at all thinking about getting this app, do it. You won’t regret it.

Trauma Informed & Tender Yoga For All! 💗. Can’t recommend Jessamyn’s teaching style enough. If anyone out there still thinks that yoga is all love n light n good vibes onlyyy, respectfully you do not know what you are talking about! Give Underbelly a try!
Amazing for every skill level.. Love the classes on here! Perfect for plus size yoga enthusiasts!

Jessamyn has healed my relationship with yoga. I have longed to have a daily yoga practice for years. Practicing with Jessmyn has transformed my experience. Rather than feeling like I “should” practice daily or like my life would somehow be better if I did, I now come to the mat from a place of pleasure and self-love. This app is magic and medicine. We are so lucky to have such a powerful, grounded and generous teacher.
Yoga for the People. Jesamyn is the kindest and funniest yoga instructor. She makes you feel welcomed and is ready to support you at any moment and stage of your yoga practice.

Best yoga app for EVERY BODY. Jessamyn has renewed my love for yoga and my body. This app has a smattering of yoga classes for anyone, anytime, any reason. Her realistic and genuine approach to classes makes you feel comfortable and most importantly she encourages you to find what fits good for your body, not just what she’s doing which I think is the center of any yoga practice because everyone’s body is unique.

UB is my FAVORITE way to do yoga!. I have been subscribing to The Underbelly for 3+ years (maybe more?). It was my savior during the pandemic and has become a part of my routine. I LOVE LOVE LOVE Jessamyn’s teaching style, I have yet to find an in-person class that I vibe with quite so much. These classes have helped me through difficult times, and now my favorite classes are as comforting as an old episode of Gilmore Girls (iykyk). I just can’t say enough good things about this app, it has helped me on my body acceptance journey and developing a consistent yoga practice. Thank you Jessamyn & The Underbelly team!

Finally enjoying yoga!. I have tried many times to get into yoga. I’m a plus sized woman and I want to improve my flexibility, but a lot of standard yoga videos are less accessible to me. These videos make it way easier to learn the different positions, and make accommodations when I can’t quite do one. Also, the practice of yoga has made me love my body more, which has been hard for me my whole life. ❤️

Excellent app, great classes!. When the last studio I attended collapsed, I was looking for an alternative that was inclusive of all body types and abilities. This has become my new virtual yoga studio.

The classes are easy to find, come at all challenge levels, and are size-inclusive. All of the classes provide modifications for poses and ways to work your way into the harder poses over time if you’d like. And Jessamyn and the other teachers encourage you every step of the way - especially where it gets hard.

And the app is easy to use and search for what you want. It’s well organized and I haven’t hit any bugs yet.
Love that the app caters to beginners and advanced. I’m a yoga beginner with a larger body and Jessamyn makes me feel welcome and capable!
Glad I found this. Good so far. The poses are really nice and different! I love it!

Falling in love with yoga and my body again. Long ago yoga became a source of pain, body hatred, and disordered eating. I left it behind and 18 years later I am coming back thanks to UB. My big, injured queer body is welcome, loved and finding joy and peace in movement and yoga! Thank you UB team!!!

Validating. Being introduced to Underbelly is the most validating experience I’ve ever had. She grabs her belly, adjust her clothing, curses , makes me feel like I am doing yoga with a good friend. She thanks you for coming and offers words of encouragement for your day. My life has been changed for the better by finding her platforms. The cost was a barrier for me for a while but this year I asked for a year long subscription as a gift from a family member and will continue to subscribe as long as it is available. I hope that she continues to make content for the next 60 years 💕Namaste ✌️
best yogi in the world!!!!!. i love their work so so much. thank you for sharing and for being you <3
Best yoga app!. Jessamyn is absolute dream
Underbelly is awesome!. Highly recommend.
Nourishing & Challenging. Absolutely in love with Jessamyn’s down to earth style, I feel like I can bring my whole self to this practice!
I hope this is a cult. I’m in!
Amazing!. The underbelly showed me I can do yoga in MY body just the way that it is right now. I don’t have to change to practice. Amazing app. A class for every feeling or need.
My yogi!. I love jessamyn and her book, my fav yoga teacher tbh. I use this app several times a week and can find a class for each type of day I'm having

Love this!. I practice with the UB 5 times a week! They have from beginner to advance yoga, as well as meditation practices for walking or resting. Super inclusive practices and such a care for creating safe environment where movement and emotions of any kind are welcomed!!

So many targeted sessions!. I love that there are so many different types of classes and classes targeted to specific areas. I have terrible neck and shoulder pain, and the classes targeted to those issues have helped me so much! I am very much a beginner, but the instruction and variations offered are excellent.

My favorite yoga app!. I absolutely love Jessamyn’s approaching, teaching style, philosophy - she makes me feel welcome on the mat no matter where I’m at or what I’m feeling. I also really appreciate the range of available classes, there is a variety of class lengths, intensity levels, areas of focus, whatever you need!

i Love the underbelly. the classes on the underbelly are some of the only guided yoga classes that nurture you on a spiritual, mental, and physical level. the accommodations for all body types has been especially helpful for me as a fat person. i really can’t recommend the underbelly enough!!! lowkey changed my life!
Best Yoga App. I love this app. Love the inclusivity!!!

Love Jessamyn!. I love Jessamyn so much! I have recently started practicing yoga. Largely through The Underbelly, but also through a local yoga studio about once a week. Every class with Jessamyn is like a warm cup of chamomile tea and a warm hug that just makes you feel cozy and safe. Jessamyn offers thoughtful insight throughout each video, it’s like you’re listening to your wise friend who you feel the most safe around. This makes the session meaningful and meditative, as well as being a good way to move my body. Jessamyn meets you right where you are at and thoughtfully guides you to develop your own yoga practice that is more helpful then just being a new exercise to try.

Actually life-changing.. I've been struggling to get back into a routine with yoga and meditation, but I've dealt with a lot of shame about not being able to do things the "right" way - in a studio (too expensive, too anxiety inducing, too hard to fit into my schedule) or even in my home (too hard for me to carve out time to roll out a mat and practice regularly). This app is $20/month, cheaper than one class at my local studio, and Jessamyn's approach to yoga really makes me feel like I can start practicing yoga anywhere, under the conditions that work for me (sitting in a chair? great! binge watching Netflix? laying in bed? great!) and without shame about my body, shape, lack of ability to follow a strict routine. I adore the short-form videos that help you do one or two simple postures to feel better while binge watching TV or otherwise rotting. But I will also find myself turning on a video to do a few minutes of stretching and then sticking around to do the whole 20-minute video (and sometimes even on my mat!!) because it feels really good. Can't recommend this app enough.

I literally couldn’t live without this app. Oh my god, where do I start? I used to do yoga videos with a VERY popular YouTube yoga teacher. And while I loved the videos initially, I began to notice myself dreading my yoga practice. I decided to try The Underbelly on a whim after following Jessamyn on Instagram since before the pandemic. It was only after I started doing these videos that I realized why I hated the other videos….I couldn’t see myself in the practice. I feel like Jessamyn truly SEES me. Everything that’s in your head during a yoga practice, she gives a voice to! If the pose feels hard, she’s gonna sympathize. If you’re in meditation and have to fart, she’s right there with you. There’s so many different videos, I truly believe there’s something for everybody. This app has turned me from a “once in a while” yoga practicer to an “every single day” practicer. No matter how my body changes day to day, Jessamyn is there to guide me through it every step of the way. Honestly the best monthly subscription I’ve ever had. I literally could not live without this app!

The best!. I’ve been doing yoga on & off for years. I always struggle in down dog and lunges are a nightmare. Jessamyn explains the poses so well and so beautifully that I actually felt good in down dog & with blocks I was able to actually roll onto my quad for the low lunge (like was that always supposed to happen? Whoops). My partner and I cannot wait to do more classes! Thank you so much for such a wonderful learning environment and such a user friendly app!
Love!. The Underbelly helps me fit yoga and meditation into my everyday life 🩷

Love her teaching, wish she had different lessons!. Love jessamyn’s energy and positivity! She is such a good teacher. I would use more if there were more short practices (10-30 min) that involves multiple poses for specific issues, like her lower back pain one

Jessamyn is a wonderful teacher!. I have learned so much and am consistently nourished by these practices. Through Jessamyn’s authentic, inclusive, and accommodating approach, I have learned to take up space and use props - to be more authentically me - not just in yoga practice but in other areas pf my life. I highly recommend The Underbelly!
Love these videos and jessamyn. Accessible, friendly way to get into and learn about yoga
Best Yoga App!. Jessamyn is a rockstar! Love how she curs the poses and offers variations. She even offers couch yoga classes 🥰
Love!. Worth the $20/month! The challenges are fun and the videos are accessible for all bodies! 🩵🩵

Not enough content to evaluate value. I decided to review this app today after seeing a post by the creator that made me uncomfortable. Creator is apparently not aware that religion and religious trappings can transcend race. For someone that you would think isn’t about commenting on appearance, they often comment on appearance. Anyway, there is no point to the app for the free version. Should be a paid only app.
Devoted fan. I tried this after a friend recommended and haven’t put this app or Jessamyn’s wisdom down. I also attended Jessamyn’s retreats in late October, all I can say is 🙏🏾 soul opening.
Loving it. This is what I’ve been waiting for
THANK YOU JESSAMYN. Finally a yoga program that isn’t taught by someone Uber thin and white. This is a god send!

Amazing teacher, great variety of classes and meditations. I love Jessamyn’s whole approach to yoga. I have gained lots of weight since I last had a regular practice, and she makes me feel like I can still do yoga “right”. She’s also incredibly thoughtful and supportive!

exceeded expectations. so grateful to this bridge between solo, at home yoga and the trial and error of finding a brick and mortar that accommodates difference and limitations. The annual cost alone, saved me from the grief of purchasing classes at a studio that might not meet my needs of the session. I don’t feel pressured to show up in any other way than as i am with Jessamyn’s app. Deeply appreciate this app and the work thats been put in by these teachers.
Revolutionary. Freeing, inclusive, revolutionary!
Exactly what I need. Tithe best yoga instruction I have ever received
My favorite yoga teacher. Jessamyn has inspired me in countless ways in areas of self-acceptance, self-love and has opened my eyes to what yoga is all about. She made me love yoga even more.

Amazing. I actually cried at the end of the first several classes I did with Jessamyn- this is exactly what I was wishing I could find- a class where my body was understood and welcomes. This is for everyone! There are options to modify and self assess, and so you see your improvements. It is a total game changer. Jessamyn is so soothing to hear.
The Underbelly is my favorite yoga app!. I’ve tried others and they seem dumb and boring compared to Jessamyn.

Game Changer. Amazing app that completely transformed my home yoga practice. New flows being added regularly to help grow the experience. Great for all levels. Love the real talk and that the descriptions of the different segments lists the poses so if you know there is a pose that is out of reach that day you can select something else. If you have an issue with curse words then this app may not be for you. Jessamyn helped me through chemo so I don’t see me ever cancelling my subscription.

Love, love, love. Best instructor. She’s so relatable and open and honest. I love it. I love the meditations. I love how accessible it all is to anyone who has done this forever or has never done yoga or meditation before. If you’re considering downloading and subscribing, just do it.
Movement for everyone. The underbelly has helped me recommit to movement when I had given up. Jessamyn is a fantastic instructor with a diverse set of sessions. Can’t recommend enough!

Best yoga app ever. Finally a yoga app for people with bigger bodies. I love yoga but hated not knowing how to practice in my own body - most apps and classes are led by much smaller humans and they never address that it’s ok to adjust for your own body, much less how to adjust postures and movements if you have extra flesh. It made me feel like I wasn’t supposed to be doing yoga. This app is dope. Seriously so helpful.

Best yoga app out there!. I love this app. Jessamyn makes yoga so so accessible. Not only do these classes make me feel aligned in my body but they also make me feel aligned in my values and my soul. Worth every penny.

Worth it. The app itself is pleasing to look at and easy to navigate. I feel like the price is really fair. Sometimes the Live classes have technical issues, but I’ve only joined two, perhaps it was a fluke.

I’m thrilled to have an instructor that looks like me and is well into their yoga journey.
I have been more consistent with practicing since downloading this App.
Love love love my UB app. Good, bad, feeling strong or weak UB has what I need in a judgment-free I-am-me vibe and I am here for all of it.
Perfect!. This app offers something for most abilities and body types. I feel comfortable and seen by this amazing teacher!

Great for Mental Health. Keeps me going physically and
mentally on some of my worse days

Immediately hooked!. If you've ever felt out of place in a yoga class this is the series you've been looking for! The Underbelly is welcoming and patient. It lets you choose the level of intensity you want while still being challenging!

An amazing app, with even better yoga. I can’t recommend the underbelly enough. After I went through severe trauma I’ve had a major disconnect from my body that led to chronic body dysmorphia. These yoga sessions have been the only place where I can connect and heal my body, and it has helped me so much. Thank you for all the help that your yoga sessions have brought me, I truly don’t know where I’d be without it

Great app, great teacher. Pros: there's a range of videos from just 5 mins to longer 40+ min sessions, things you can do from your couch or whole body get out the blocks and blanket let's get into it mode. As someone with chronic pain, it's easier to commit to a practice when I know I can show up on days I'm in crippling pain and not further injury myself because there are videos that are suited for that. Invaluable insight for physical adjustments if you're fat, has truly leveled up the yoga experience for me.

Best Yoga Teacher I Have Ever Had!. Jessamyn Stanley is a superb teacher and a precious gift to ALL bodies, everywhere!

I joined Underbelly during the early days of the Covid lockdowns and it was a lifesaver, even with only a few videos. I practiced then with my tween son - his world was opened to yoga being for him too. My own practice continues to deepen. 

The app is user-friendly and wonderfully designed too.
Love it. Everything I’ve ever wanted from a yoga joint. Thank you 🐝💜✨🤘🏻
Accessible and practical yoga. Love!!!!!
Great app. I love Jessamyn’s instructor style! She’s great and the app works just fine. Highly recommend!

The Best Yoga Instructor Ever!. Jessamyn Stanley is the best! As an instructor, she is chill, genuine, funny, accessible, inclusive, and passionate. I had fallen off of my exercise routine due to chronic back pain, but have recently gotten to the point that I can handle gentle yoga again. This app has so many great options for someone struggling with pain or other limitations. I love that I can take a 10 minute class and feel refreshed and more at home in my body. I just finished the “Getting Existential” class and the affirmations that Jessamyn spoke at the end actually made me cry (in a good way). I can’t say enough good things about her and the offerings on this app! ♥️

Love this space. Just started exploring this app and so far so great! I have been a follower of Jessamyn for some time so it feels good to support her awesome work. Love the body neutral/body love, goofiness and vulnerability she brings to yoga. The best in the game.

all time favorite yoga app. I’ve been using this app for over a year now, including through the most difficult time of my life. I love Jessamyn’s teaching style so much. It has really clicked with me. It’s gentle and affirming, not presumptive, and you really feel like you’re in the same room (or at least on the same zoom haha). Thank you so much for being you unapologetically.

Supportive practice for all bodies. Jessamyn does an incredible job creating space for whatever body you have (a larger body for me) and reminds you to pay attention to and honor your body throughout the practice. I am so grateful that she is a part of my personal practice and she has helped me to shift and let go of some very toxic internalized fat phobia. 10/10 recommend ✨

Refreshing. I’ve done yoga off and on for years, but with Underbelly I feel like I can finally stick with it. I’ve learned how to do yoga with the body I’m in, rather than trying to fit into a shape that isn’t accessible for me.

Best investment! Great App, great teacher. The title says it all. For the price of 1 drop in class a month, I’ve got access to tons of classes I can do at home. jessamyn is such a great teacher-
So real and I love her use of props and subtle suggestions for finding a little something different in a pose. I’m always amazed how she says just what I need to hear at the right time during a class.
Best yoga I ever tried!. I seriously love it! Jessamyn is funny and it really seems to understand the struggle. I love that is not a whitewash yoga and it is more than a fitness routine.

Amazing for all bodies!. I really love how kind, gentle and aware The underbelly is of the modifications needed when a body shape or disability falls outside of the ‘traditional’ idea. It’s so hard to find wellness videos geared towards larger bodies and the challenges that come with movement instructed without this in mind. I feel confident in building up my strength and flexibility and everyday I find myself easing more and more into my routines. If you honestly have ever taken yoga and wondered ‘That’s cool but really what do I do with my belly getting in the way here?’ Than this video is for you!
I LOVE JESSAMYN AND UNDERBELLY YOGA. Jessamyn has completely changed my perception of yoga, my body, and what it feels like to be aligned and present within myself.

So glad I finally downloaded!. My therapist planted the seed about The Underbelly a few years ago as I was working on my relationship with food. Now, I’m working on my relationship with movement and Jessamyn has been a wonderful guide to connecting with my body in a new and beautiful way. I grow in every class. Thank you, Jessamyn for creating this space!

Love The Underbelly app!. Taking an in person class from Jessamyn Stanley is a literal dream and this app is the next close thing! Tons of information, flows and poses for every day and special occasions, all wrapped in the unapologetic compassion and bright love that Jessamyn is known for. 10/10 I use this app daily for my physical and mental well being.
Love the app!. This is an amazing app and user experience.
Great. Great

All-bodies Inclusive. Love the underbelly yoga! Transitioned from in person classes to this app during pandemic and not going back. I’m a large body person and the modifications for large chest etc, that a “typical” yoga instructor body doesn’t need, are fantastic! Plenty here for advanced yogies and for ultra beginners alike. THANK YOU JESSAMYN.
The best yoga platform. Experiencing The underbelly is experiencing unconditional LOVE. For us By us🫂💜
The Best. From beginner to experienced, The Underbelly makes yoga feel purposeful without taking itself too seriously.

Relatable, accessible, empowering. I came to this app knowing yoga would benefit my body, but consistently hating it as a fat person in a practice that’s encouraged almost exclusively for small bodies. Jess turned that around in the first session. I find myself cheering and celebrating accomplishments, thanking my body for its abilities and learning how to move and breathe in a way that suites me. Thank you, Jess and Underbelly. What a gift.

Jessamyn is PERFECT. Love this app, love her work, love her. Not only is she soul healing and wise, she makes yoga accessible and equitable to everyone. She is THE VOICE I want to see for yoga. Her philosophy, her character... it all comes together in this cozy, self-affirming package with this app. Well worth the $10 a month.

Thank you, Jessamyn. The Underbelly is incredible. I’ve practiced yoga for a long time but it wasn’t until I found Jessamyn and The Underbelly that I felt like I was finally doing the yoga my body was made for. I love Jessamyn’s approach to movement and yoga she’s literally made me laugh and cry in the same video. The app is easy to navigate and I love that I can search on keywords like “stress” to find the practice I need for any given moment. Thank you to Jessamyn and all the folks that have made the UB happen. I’m so grateful.

Love love love. Y’all-the only thing better than Jessamyn guiding your practice is being high while Jessamyn is guiding your practice. Her directions are clear, her adjustments and variations are helpful for any level of yoga or body, and it’s a joy to practice with someone who is authentic, gloriously human, funny, and generous.
Do it!. This app is AWESOME!

Love Jessamyn, love the app!. Doing yoga with Jessamyn is one of the best parts of my day. The app is easy to navigate and the class descriptions allow you to choose exactly what you need for the day.

And then she said.... This has been the greatest yoga experience ever. I have felt comfortable and safe every step of the way even if I wasn’t physically comfortable at the time. She is also hilarious.
I love Jessamyn. This is the only online yoga I have loved. Jessamyn is an inspiration and a joy to practice with.
Amazing boost to home practice. Underbelly make it easy to hold your home practice. Tons of content, classes of all lengths and challenge levels. I love it!

Jessamyn is THE BEST. The Underbelly yoga is my favorite yoga app EVER. I love how Jessamyn breaks down poses, exudes positivity, support, and encouragement, and gives you laughs along the way of your personal yoga journey. The Underbelly is inclusive of all body types, levels, and ages!! Thank you Jessamyn (and team!) for making it clear and accessible that yoga is for everybody and every BODY. :)
Great app. Worth the subscription
Helps me be a better teacher. I learn something new every class!

So nourishing for body and soul. I love this app. It has met me where I am no matter what my body or my heart needed. Great short and long sessions, meditations, and foundational work. Highly recommend

Yoga that makes me feel truly seen. I’ve been in love with yoga my entire life but have felt less and less like yoga was for me as I got older. Jessamyn and The Underbelly have changed that entirely. As my body changes, there’s always space for me here. The understanding and compassion that each practice is crafted with is like a warm hug from a good friend. I feel supported, I feel challenged, I feel welcome. I would encourage anyone who loves yoga or who has ever been interested in starting a yoga practice to give The Underbelly a try.
Love it!. Jessamyn is an excellent teacher!
Just what I needed!. This was recommended by a friend and is just what I needed!! Such a great body-positive yoga class that focuses more on the internal than the external of the postures!

Inclusive and Wonderful. I’ve previously used free yoga videos online, and they never told me how to make adjustments for my body shape. I never felt acknowledged, and it was physically uncomfortable for me. The Underbelly was recommended by a friend and I’ll never look back. Jessamyn has been the most wonderful instructor, and I love laughing occasionally in the middle of a flow. She cracks me up and shares how to make space for my body. I have never made so much use of a paid online exercise service - and I don’t plan to be without it as long as it’s available

Best yoga experience ever!. Jess Amun is a fantastic teacher and I love the variety of videos available, which you can use for many different goals of practice. There are tons of pose modifications available and I always leave the mat feeling validated and refreshed. I am definitely someone who has previously balked at classes because of concerns about body type, gender expression, and skill level but have always felt welcomed and seen by Jessamyn’s classes. Plus you can’t beat the subscription price! Thank you so much for everything you do ❤️

I can do yoga. Un-f’n-believable.. I love everything about this series. I feel inspired, hopeful, capable, strong and even powerful when I follow these yoga sessions. After many years and many teachers (who knew nothing about how a fat female body moves) I am finally able to ‘get’ yoga … and I love it. It will probably take me a year to get through all these videos, but I hope there are more by the time I get there. Can’t stop, won’t stop.

Yoga made simple and accessible. I’ve never felt more comfortable with contorting my body into yoga position than with the expertise and guidance of Jessamyn!!! I now practice nearly daily and have become the most comfortable in my body that I’ve ever been. Much appreciation and thanks

She knows what I need. Jessamyn just always says what I need her to say to make it work, like she knows how my body needs to move better than I do. I’ve never felt like yoga fit before, but now it’s does and it’s nice.
Welcoming and Healing. Jessamyn is a marvel. Through this tiny phone screen she shares light and love and so many small ways to show gratitude for the body you are in.

Absolutely amazing!. I love practicing with Jessamyn. Her authenticity comes through in every flow, from her cueing to her commentary, it feels like I am connecting with an old friend every time. I am so grateful for her promotion of props! As a larger bodied woman, the Underbelly has enabled me to deepen my practice with modifications and props to make even the most challenging postures accessible.

Love The Underbelly!!. Do yourself a favor and sign up with The Underbelly. Jessamyn’s instruction allows me to challenge myself or make modifications if I need them for that day/pose. She also makes me laugh and she’s so relatable it further helps me relax into my practice. It seems more accessible than most to me. It’s definitely more affordable than any other subscription or membership I’ve seen. I’m a beginner in yoga and also a fan of Jessamyn, I was scouting the internet for every yoga video of theirs that I could find so when I saw this app, I knew I had to subscribe. These classes are necessarily for those looking for a fusion of yoga and high intensity workout, but if you are looking to deepen your practice, learn foundational poses and lessons of yoga then Jessamyn may be the perfect teacher for you. She offers a simplified set of classes that challenge students and also pull them in and motivate me to get to my mat everyday. Worth the money because I love her style and supporting the work!

Best Instructor Ever. Jessamyn makes you feel comfortable in your own skin. Even when you’re sure you may not be doing the pose exactly right. I’ve taken the breath work we learn in the class and applied it to everyday life to help with my severe anxiety. Overall, this has been the best yoga/exercise app/class I’ve ever experienced.

Amazing and affirming. I can’t say enough good things about the Underbelly! Jessamyn keeps it real and manages to be encouraging without seeming over the top. This is the one yoga app I keep coming back to and the subscription cost is well with the content. Jessamyn provides in depth breakdowns of yoga postures as well as flows in the app. She’s taught me how to be appreciative of my body and that it’s perfectly ok to make adjustments to the poses based on my body.

Joy!. I have never experienced this much joy while practicing yoga. I have practiced off/on for about 15 years and I have never felt so affirmed in my practice. And it is literally because Jessamyn is who she is and let’s that infiltrate her teaching. I often am the one cussin’ or modifying every asana and going at my own pace in the midst of a class where everyone feels like they have to keep up with the instructor. Jessamyn is cultural relevant pedagogy in action. Bravo! 👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾

Jessamyn is a GODDESS. This yoga is inclusive and non judgmental. There is a yoga class in here for every level, from complete beginner to advanced. I look forward to this as a regular part of my self care routine!

Do it for yourself. I had a mental block about yoga. I thought I didn’t have a yoga body because I have big boobs and a belly. When I would try yoga, if I couldn’t do it like all the other yoga girls I was mean to myself. Jessamyn changed ALL of that in 2 sessions. One day my brain just flipped the switch. I noticed that I was PRAISING myself in my thoughts! I was doing yoga and LAUGHING! I was making happy noises and feeling intense gratitude. Now I know I have a yoga body because (a) I have a body and (b) I do yoga. I don’t do perfect yoga. But whatever I can achieve on that particular day is enough. Do this for yourself. Let Jessyman lead you down the path to freedom from your distorted thinking and into joyous freedom!

So much more than I expected. I never review apps but Jessamyn Stanley and The Underbelly have done SO much for me! I downloaded during the Covid stay at home orders and it is adding everything to my life. I’ve always been discouraged trying to do yoga, and I never really *got* what I was trying to do with yoga. I understand now and I’m so grateful. I’ve never done any sort of activity like this so consistently for such a long period of time. I look forward to my practice every day and find so much mental and emotional balance as the world navigates this pandemic. If you are looking for something to tether to during all this insanity, this might be a great choice for you.

Amazing. This such an amazing app with yoga routines for people with larger bodies! It’s such a self esteem boost and it moves at a pace that is right for my body. I first saw Jessamyn on a Lane Bryant YouTube video and she inspired me to do more yoga. I just happened upon this app one day and feel beyond grateful to have found it! I love love love this app!
Powerful. Thank you Jessamyn! You’ve changed the way I think about yoga, my body, and my personal struggles.

Wow. What a breath of fresh air. I feel like my practice is now my own and I belong on the mat with Jessamyn. I need to be able to laugh and get deep into my practice and this app has that balance. Just yes.

BEST YOGA TEACHER EVER. I absolutely love Jessamyn Stanley I think she’s an amazing yoga teacher but also an amazing human being all around. (Seriously, look her up) 

 The way that this app is set up is SO GREAT. Building blocks of yoga are hard to find especially on an online class but this is your jackpot. Great for beginners and great for long time practicing yogis who may want to reacquaint themselves with the intricate details of each pose. Honestly, I recommend this for anyone because this is proof that yoga is for all shapes and sizes! 

Plus, if y’all lonely and need a friend, Jessamyn is funny, beautiful, full of wisdom, and gives such unconditional love. Enjoy!
Wonderful. Thank you so much for these classes! You’re a wonderful teacher.

My fave yoga teacher ever. Jessamyn is the best. I love this app and her teaching style. No matter what mood I'm in, how I'm feeling, or what else is going on in my life, during class with Jessamyn I feel like I'm taking care of myself AND being taken care of by Jessamyn. I'm so excited to continue following these classes.

Grateful. Thank you so very much for offering this practice. This is my new favorite way to start my day and it helps me navigate the rest of my day more thoughtfully and with greater presence. As a fat woman, I feel so welcomed and respected and held with love. Thank you, Jessamyn!

Yay. I have been away from yoga for a while. This is a perfect, funny, forgiving, step-by-step return. Jessamyn is the antidote for the stretchier-than-thou instructors. We can actually hear her breathing hard sometimes which makes me feel better about breathing hard sometimes. My one question is will there be new content released?

Favorite part of my day. I just started implementing this yoga practice to begin and end my days and it has already helped my daily mindset so much. Right now especially it’s so important to take care of yourself, and Jessamyn’s classes are fun and no pressure. I’ve been doing yoga for years but I’m still loving even her beginner classes! Highly recommend for anyone who already loves yoga, and especially for those looking to get started in a new practice.
This app is everything. 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥
Love Jessamyn!!. I know I’m gonna leave my mat feeling better about myself and the world when I start one of these classes. Can’t recommend enough

I Would Follow Jessamyn Off a Cliff. I have tried every yoga app out there. Or at least it feels like it. With The Underbelly, I feel like I’m “getting it” for the first time ever. Jessamyn is so real and doesn’t try to be fake zen. She’s just herself. And she gives you room to be yourself too.

Jessamyn is an angel. Like many of us who probably use this app, I am a larger woman. I have been large my whole life. It is so refreshing to have someone teach yoga who is mindful of body types and limitations and where a bigger body feels right. 

I couldn’t recommend this more. I’m someone who has been petrified of exercise their whole life due to their size and all the judgement and ignorance that comes with it and while I always turn back to yoga every couple of years I have never felt so seen and understood and welcome.
Welcoming. Jessamyns practice is the most inviting space I have ever been welcomed into. This practice is truly authentic and raw and everything I have been looking for in a yoga app.

This is everything.. I’ve been waiting to do yoga for a few years because as a trans white person I wanted to find an instructor who was not white, was not appropriating yoga, went at an easy pace, and was a queer person. I finally found everything I wanted in an instructor in Jessamyn! I have never felt so emotionally and spiritually connected before. Her classes have given me much more than I could ever repay her for 💗

Jessamyn is my favorite yoga teacher. Uh this is so good. I went on a yoga hiatus for like a year and thought yoga wasn’t for me but Jessamyn as my teacher taught me how wrong I was! Jessamyn’s so calming, funny, and just sooooo real and accepting. I 10/10 recommend. Also, in the past, I’ve had a hard time at online yoga, but not with Jessamyn because it’s just priceless you just wanna spend all your time doing yoga and being at peace and practicing gratitude surrounded and inspired by Jessamyn. Do it!

My saviorrr. Yoga can seem competitive or build insecurities at times, like an unsolicited humble brag, BUT Jesamyn’s attitude totally helps me stay motivated! I feared the level of inclusivity meant it wouldn’t be as challenging but it’s definitely a healthy challenge for all. I love it!

Loving this!. I’ve been practicing yoga for over ten years, but had taken a bit of a break after the birth of our last baby. This series has been just what I needed to get back into yoga. Jessamyn is a delightful teacher. I’ve only made it through one track so far, but hope she adds more tracks sometime soon because these are great!

Jessamyn is amazing!. I used to regularly practice yoga when I was a teen and in my early 20’s. I’ve wanted to get back into it, but so many poses that were easy are now extremely difficult (I’ve had a few surgeries and injuries and I’m not as active and flexible). I’ve always been fat and always felt like I was only accepted in yoga classes because I was the “good fatty” who was active and strong. That also kept me away. I’ve followed Jessamyn and a few other folks who are my size that practice yoga for a while. Her app convinced me after the trial period, as it helped me reconnect with old poses in a new way. And more importantly it helped me connect with my breath. I plan to keep it up and build my own practice again. Representation is so important!

E for Everybody. I tried yoga in the past several different times but always fell off. With The Underbelly, I feel empowered and encouraged to come back every day. Jessamyn gives so many pose variations and designed the classes to build on one another. Having a WOC instructor is also a huge advantage.

Love it!!!. As a fat yogi, it is so amazing to see representation and once I heard about the app through the Broccoli Talk podcast I switched from the one that I was using immediately!!! Keep thriving, girl!
Loving this app!. So easy to use and full of great vibes and information

Best Yoga Ever!. I love Jessamyn! I have been doing yoga for 30 years now and have been more into than ever because of her and the Under Belly app. I appreciate how real she is and the emphasis of welcoming all bodies and people. She also has so many gems to share. Thank you!
Cannot unsubscribe. Jessamyn is awesome! I don’t use the app and cannot unsubscribe. It’s awful. I have no idea how this was developed, but it needs a fix ASAP
They make unsubscribing as hard as possible. They hold you hostage and won’t let you unsubscribe.

Only get this if you want it forever.. Jessamyn is amazing and this is NO REFLECTION OF HER TEACHING AT ALL. But only get this app if you know you’re going to want it forever and you know you’ll always be able to afford it. I’ve been trying to unsubscribe for months but there’s 0 support in both the app itself and the AppStore. Leaving this review is the closest thing to sending an email for help that I can get.
incredible. i’m so jazzed about a whole yoga app made/ presented by a fat black queer woman. it’s so important to see fat bodies doing yoga, let alone teaching it beautifully. thank you, jessamyn!

Worth it!. This app is worth every single penny to me. Jessamyn is an amazing teacher and truly is authentic in all of her classes. What she says gives me confidence that I can do it and keeps me coming back for more. I’ve never enjoyed my yoga practice so much before.

Best yoga for every body. It feels so good to do this yoga with Jessamyn, to be given permission to be imperfect and encouraged to breathe and gently stretch. It’s been transformative so far. 
I wish there was an option to download videos or watch on a Windows device/desktop, because I often don’t have access to WiFi in the same place/time as I can do yoga.
Fee. I feel, if an app is a paid app it should say so before you download it, be upfront with your clients, honesty is key
Love this app!. I love the instruction. Love her attitude about life and yoga.

Best instructor ever!. I've been struggling through group yoga classes for years, and I've never fully understood the poses until Jessamyn explained them. She also makes me feel welcome and like I'm progressing.

This is changing me for the better. I’ve been forced into yoga classes in the past. I’ve tried to mold my body to be the same as my teachers, my classmates. I was miserable doing yoga. 

With this, I’ve found true joy. I laugh. It’s fun. I don’t feel like I’m doing it “wrong.” And I love it.

Amazing. My beloved studio closed 2 weeks ago, and I’ve been in a funk because I knew It would be hard to find a new body positive and inclusive space with down to earth instructors. Then here’s Jessamyn right on time! This practice feels good and honest. I’m so grateful.

If you’ve ever been intimidated by yoga this is where you belong. As a plus size gal, I’ve always been intimidated by yoga... yoga teachers, yoga poses and most certainly yoga classes. Jessamyn was the first teacher I found (online at that!) who could make yoga relatable for me and take away the intimidating feelings I had toward it all. She’s such an incredible teacher and I’m so excited she now has an app so people like me can connect even further to her yoga teachings!

The most affirming yoga. Jessamyn is so supportive and encouraging. Her message of focusing on what YOUR body needs and how YOUR body actually works is something that even experienced yogis need to come back to. She also has the most honest and authentic voice in yoga everyone has so much they could learn from her, and this is a great platform for that.

Have paid but can’t get app to work. Have already subscribed and nothing is working. I keep landing on subscription page...with no way to move to activities. Also the email from iTunes says I can cancel my subscription by “March 6,2019”

I want to love the app but I can’t :(

Get This App. Now.. When Jessamyn speaks, I feel validation. My body is not wrong. My movements are not wrong, everything I do in my practice is what needs to be done. She emphasizes this first and foremost, allowing you to completely give yourself over to your practice. I have attended many yoga classes in person, and no teacher has allowed me this much freedom. There is no language barrier to yoga here. Everyone is welcome, so please join. App is super user friendly and simple. We go there to do work and to reflect. Absolutely wonderful.
Dive in to get started!. This is a great app with tons of videos and resources all for less than a single yoga class. Start or grow your practice with an amazing instructor.

Multi-media fan. I’m a plus size gal who has started the journey towards having bariatric surgery. Part of the journey has been trying to figure out what I am physically able to do. I wanted to try yoga as a start to getting myself on track. I wanted to watch someone who wasn’t the stereotypical gym rat though. I searched YouTube for plus size yoga, and instantly fell in love with your channel. I then began following you on Instagram, and was so excited when I saw the posts about coming out with the app! Can’t wait to learn more from Jessamyn! So incredible! Thank you for everything you do!

Accessible yoga for a new mom. I’m obsessed with this app! It’s user friendly, affordable, and I can pick and choose how and when I practice yoga. Thank you for creating a way for me to stretch, get stronger, and get in touch with my body each day!
Problems accessing app. I subscribed but just keep getting a message that I’ve already purchased but app can’t connect to iTunes. Is this just my phone or are others having issues?

Underbelly!. Listen folks, this is your chance to be about all the yoga philosophies we love to discuss so much. Support this woman. Support a Black business. Support a genuine teacher who has dedicated herself to the craft. And while you’re at it, respect the work it took for her and her team to get here.
Amazing!. I love Jessamyn and have been following her practice for years. So excited to finally be able to be taught by her! Love this so much!

Fantastic. The Underbelly has a huge variety of classes available, so there’s something for everybody, and something for every body. Only have 5 minutes, no bother there’s a class for that. Want to push yourself, there’s a class for that. Just want to meditate and re-centre, there’s a class for that. Really easy to drop in and find something that suits your mood and energy for the day.
Thank you!. UB is part of my daily routine. It’s easy to use and there’s so many videos to choose from! It’s like practicing yoga with a friend.

Love love love. Trying to get back into regular practice, and UB has been a key for me! Jessamyn has a way of making you feel like every manifestation and bit of yourself if worthy of the love and care practice brings and makes me laugh and see myself as capable every video! Didn’t know practicing yoga could feel so uplifting and accessible and I love love love this!

Love love love. I love everything about UB and the app is great! Quite like Jessamyn says, the sub cost a month is what you would pay for one yoga class at studio, and there are so many great classes on this app.

Sooo good!. I have practiced yoga on and off for years, but had recently fallen out of doing my own regular practice. I think I was overthinking and putting pressure on myself. 

I’ve had all sorts of bad relationships with my body, movement and exercise in the past, so I’m careful who I choose as a teacher. 

I listened to Dear Jessamyn and read Yoke, so I chose the underbelly because I know that Jessamyn is impeccable. She is a safe space. She is practicing yoga in everything she does and reminds me to do the same. 

I have practiced yoga every day since I got the app. I love the classes. I love the major arcana series and can’t wait to do them all! 

Thank you so much to everyone responsible for this app. You’re amazing.

Amazing, inclusive and life-changing. Until I discovered Jessamyn I didn’t think exercise was me or my body shape! Her classes make yoga possible, adaptations are in place as part of the practice unlike other classes I’ve attended in past where you feel judged and useless. 
Underbelly classes are funny, not too serious and challenge me and my body in ways I didn’t think was possible, I love the fact that Jessamyn says when something hurts or acknowledges the difficulty. I can’t live without yoga now, the benefits on my mental and physical health has been life-changing. The app provides different levels and new classes all the time, some days I do the same class, my go-to, Bellies Brew❤️ other days I mediate, lately I’ve been loving the new Major Arcana classes. Thank you for helping me love Yoga! 🙏🏻🧘🏻‍♀️❤️

How to fall in love with yoga…. Finally yoga lessons that are fun and different! 

I have been trying to fall in love with yoga for at least 8 years. I have done lessons in person and through youtube and downloaded several yoga apps.

They were all good, I felt good afterwards when I forced myself to attend… but it kept being boring and difficult. Furthermore, the teachers are often slim, fit and extremely flexible. So were the other attendants when I went to in person classes. I felt so out of place and frustrated. 

Jessamyn is totally different: she is helping me to trust and listen my body, accept myself here and now and challenge myself when I feel ready. So far it is the only practice I have kept every day! 

If you are also bored of all the look alike lessons and teachers, go ahead and give a shot to this amazing app! From her website you can get two weeks trial for $1 (equals to £0.79 I think?)
The best yoga app.. A staple to my safety in my body and mind- practice with Jessamyn is a constant in my chaos and I’m so grateful for this app and these moments.

Life changing. I’ve had an underbelly subscription for probably just over a year now and have been practicing mostly on/off until November last year when I decided to really commit. Almost every single morning I’ve woken up and done at least 15 minutes of yoga with Jessamyn and at this point if I don’t have much time in the morning I’d rather skip my morning coffee than my yoga.

Absolutely love it. I have been practicing yoga for a couple of years and absolutely love this app and Jessamyn’s teaching style. Its been really good to ground me back in the practice and process of yoga rather than focusing on the end result and look of the postures. The classes are light but still allow you the opportunity to challenge yourself. Exactly what I needed.
Just wonderful. I love how relaxed Jessamyn is, and also her tuition is clear and empowering. A wonderful range of classes and tutorials. Suitable for any level of yogi.
Amazing app. Would absolutely recommend this for anyone trying yoga for the first time or trying to make a point of getting onto the mat regularly for however much practice

JESS HAS SAVED MY SOUL. During covid & lockdown & looming climate chaos, jess has been a beacon off happiness and saved my soul. I love her. I love her yoga. I love how inclusion and real she is. MORE PLEASE!

Great app :). This app is a great way to introduce yourself to a regular yoga practice. Jessamyns teaching style is relaxed and inclusive, and she has an intuitive way of helping you to accept yourself and truly become present in your practice ! Highly recommended this app started me on my yoga journey a year ago and I am enjoying and growing as I move through it :) namaste

Jessamyn is your new best friend!. I adore everything about Jessamyn and her yoga. I’ve been searching for so long for a yoga instructor who gets that I’m not that flexible, not that fit and certain not skinny! Jessamyn makes me feel that I’m good enough to do yoga, that on the days when I’m struggling, doing a little something rather than nothing is perfectly okay. Her honest, down to earth, inclusive, funny approach is wonderful. She makes me feel better about myself, just for landing on my mat. She wholeheartedly makes yoga all about self care, not about comparing how high (or low in my case) you can get your legs in the air. Her tips on where to stash your belly and your boobs when they’re getting in the way are warm, human and hilarious. I truly love this woman and everything she is about. Thank you for coming into my life (well, a corner of my living room anyway) and allowing me to embrace yoga. You da best! ❤️

Refreshing yoga app. I’ve just started using this wonderful app to increase my regular practice. The sessions are relaxed, encouraging and a really refreshing way to practice yoga! Would recommend to everyone!

Best yoga ever. Love Jessamyn and their style of teaching. Fat and queer friendly and teaches you to move to appreciate and honour your body. That doesn’t mean you don’t sweat and feel the heat, you do. But well-being is focus.
Wonderful. The best yoga class I have ever attended. You hold space for people in a really beautiful way. Thank you.
Excellent. Supportive and empowering practice with one of the greatest yoga teachers I’ve encountered yet.

Highly recommend!. Particularly during Covid-19 lockdown, Jessamyn’s yoga sessions have brought calm, introspection, heat and joy to my days. A yoga class that offers so many alternatives to postures, encourages props and celebrates you!
Keeping me sane through lockdown. Ive practised yoga on snd off for years. Im learning new things and connecting to the more spiritual side of yoga. Jessamyn’s style is fabulous.

Yoga practice like no other. The sequences in this app are so beautifully, mindfully crafted to make the practitioner truly think about what their body is doing and what feels good for them not what it ‘should’ look like. I’m into it.
YOU HAVE TO PAY. You … have … to … pay…. But probably worth it
Amazing ✨. Love it!
Hell yes. Yoga for all bodies. Great selection. Great instructors

Nice app. I really liked this app and the content. I had to stop using it due to financial reasons, but I want to applaud the fact that you don’t automatically renew the subscriptions. It is an honest practice, so thank you for that!

Whyyyy the autoplay??. Love the philosophy behind this app, however the app itself? Not great. Get rid of the autoplay or have an option to toggle it off.

Obsessed.. Jessamyn is just full of calming, empowering, grounding wisdom. I leave every class feeling more compassionate for myself and just some legit amount more happier. Can’t recommend her enough.

The best app. Jessamyn Stanley is brilliant. I have never felt comfortable doing yoga until I found Jessamyn’s videos. I am a fat, disabled person and yoga is so accessible now! Awesome app, very easy to use!
Worth every penny. Jessamin is an amazing yoga instructor :)
Inclusive and inviting yoga. Much more motivated to do yoga when it is with Jessamyn! Makes me love movement and love my body and what it can do. Will always continue to subscribe
If you need some help with self-love. Jessamyn’s got you

Wonderful yoga app. I’ve been using the underbelly consistently since it launched. Jessamyn is the best yoga instructor I’ve ever had. She provides modifications for people with fat bodies and people who are working on their flexibility. 

I’ve noticed improvements in my physical, mental and spiritual health every time I use this app consistently.
Engaging classes. There are lots of options and Jessamyn is a fun, clear and creative teacher.
my favourite yoga app by farrr. amazing

Outstanding classes. Classes: Jessamyn is a gifted teacher. Hilarious, relatable, wise, accessible, revolutionary. My body, heart, and soul feel so good after practice with Jessamyn. It’s truly a space where you can come as you are. The cameos by animal friends are always a delightful surprise too. 

App itself: I find the organization of the videos/app a little unclear. I would love to see the ability to filter searches by duration and intensity of practice, and body part focus at the same time. Being able to create folders in my library would be awesome as well.

Amazing. Jessamyn and the Underbelly are fantastic. Approachable and inclusive yoga practices for all bodies. This is truly the first time I’ve ever felt seen and safe in a yoga space and it’s well worth the price (which is less than a single studio class) - I have been singing the underbelly’s praises since I started with them. The app itself is pretty basic but it does what it needs to do.
Love it!. Great videos, motivational and inspirational in all the right ways. Feeling good inside and out 💕

Life changing. Great non-colonialised yoga that is accessible for all. Meditations that will open your heart. Jessamyn is a godsend. Yoga and health is for all bodies, and I’m thrilled to have found this great resource (and I hated yoga).

Relatable and puts me in a zen place. I love yoga with Jessamyn, she is funny and down to earth and give you info but also tells you don't stress over it and that certain positions take ages to perfect bit to do what you can. Love my time doing yoga with her.

So THIS is what I’ve been missing. The underbelly has been life changing for me, no joke. I’ve taken yoga for years before and thought I really “got it”- truth was I never felt safe or represented in those classes as a woman in a body that is 6’2” and 330lbs. Jessamyn is so real, so vulnerable and radiates loves in a way that reaches through the screen and supports me through the poses. These classes are powerful, and I will keep coming back.

Ohhh hell yeah. I absolutely love using the Underbelly App. 

Jessamyn is hilarious, real, and pushes me mentally - allowing me to do things I thought weren’t accessible to someone in a bigger body. 

I love that Underbelly is unlike other yoga videos in that Jessamyn swears, talks about the ways certain practices will help during sex, and invites you to become vulnerable in the positions. 

I never leave reviews so this in itself speaks volumes. xx
The Under Belly. Amazing classes, varied options and suitable for all levels!

So grateful for this app!. So grateful to have access to yoga content by a wonderfully honest and sarcastic black woman. It’s like having your friend lead your yoga class. Classes are short but still feel like you’re helping your body. Happy to support!
Yoga for everyone. Jessamyn talks yoga in a way that makes the poses understandable and it’s like my body is now finally getting yoga. It’s helped me so much through a stressful time.

Fantastic!. Jessamyn is such a wonderful, supportive teacher. She helps you build a yoga practice in such a wonderful way: Slow and steady with a thoughtfully constructed journey through different shapes and movements. Screw any ego or expectations and just do what your body needs. Thank you!!

Oh mama!. I never thought it was possible for me to love yoga. I’ve done every kind of class possible and hated it. I kept coming back to the practice and truly never understood why. I just needed to find the underbelly and Jessamyn. I love these classes. The instruction is amazing, love the app, I have it on my Roku and devices so I can do it literally anywhere! Thank you!

You won’t regret this app!. Jessamyne is amazing. She directs so well and always encourages you to do what you need to do even if it differs from her instructions. WWJD?. What Would Jessamyn Do! My new life motto.

Underbelly yoga must try. I’ve done yoga a few times at a studio, this experience was so much better. The only yoga I’ve ever done that made me smile. Jessamin is so real in each class and encourages you to take all the space for your body and offers many variations. 10/10 would recommend

I ♥️ the Underbelly. 55min of yoga this morning watching the snow fall!

This app is the bomb! The yogi is ultra real & instructs for all body types. 

Move you belly if you have one & be grateful for its softness

So positive, accessible, and funny. I have physical disabilities & am a bigger gal...this app is perfect! 

100 stars, totally recommend! ♥️

Love love love!. Love using this app. Sometimes I don’t really feel like doing yoga but then I start anyway and I feel so good when I’m done. Jessamyn is really supportive and motivational while still being reasonable, validating, and providing humour. Very happy with this and look forward to using it even more. Thanks Jessamyn!

Down-to-earth, real and self-accepting. I can’t get enough of Jessamyn’s yoga. She subtly coaxes me toward greater self-love and meets me where I am at: potty mouth, warts and all. If you want to cut the garbage, do some yoga and learn to love yourself, this is for you.
Best yoga app ever. This is my favourite way to do yoga! The most accessible and fun instructor I’ve ever practiced with.

Best yoga videos/app I’ve ever tried.. Honestly. Jessamyn is a blessing. Yoga for every body, wherever you are, she’ll meet you there and push you to go a little further if you’re up for it. I cried like a bb. Support this yoga goddess, folks!

Start from the beginning. Have done yoga for more than 15 years, learning so much about the poses, my breath, and how I need to slow down in my movement. Jessymyn is an authentic, loving, and encouraging teacher.

Absolutely recommend!. I LOVE jessamyn!! I have tried a lot of different online yoga classes and personally this one is my favourite for a number of reasons. I cannot stress this enough…. I cannot stress this enough this app has made such a dramatic difference in my mental health and as a perk I’m noticing benefits for my physical health as well (see what I did there, I flipped it). 
Jessamyn’s approach to yoga is just my ideal, I’m not saying anything about how it “should” be done I know next to nothing about the history of yoga, all I’m saying is that her kindness and self acceptance and love is aspirational in a healthy way. Because you don’t need to change anything but your mindset to achieve the same thing for yourself. 
She does things like makes you feel good about tuning into your body and using modified options instead of being like “and hey if you can’t do what I’m doing because you suck, do what this other tiny person is doing not because they have to but because someone has to show you (rubbish at this) the technique”. Look that might be my negative self talk running wild but that how I always felt.

I really wanted to start integrating moving my body more into my life, I'm on that stage of the anti diet culture Intuitive eating road, but it’s hard you know? I’ve used exercise as punishment, I’ve gotten fixated obsessed tried to use calculators to estimate the amount of my body I can erase by doing x amount of exercise. I’ve literally had a plan to lose enough weight in private so I could exercise, no joke. Moving for the love of moving? Moving as a protective measure to strengthen my muscles so as to not hurt myself in my physical job? Moving just for the sake of it? No, never. 

As a fat person I was bitterly ashamed and scared of going to the gym or exercising in public and sometimes even in private so disheartened by what I saw as my lack of moral character hanging off me as fat.

Underbelly, cracked open a space for me to just be. Just be with myself and my body to challenge myself and show myself kindness. 
If you’re like me and you can’t seem to exercise without weight loss obsession- even when I would start exercising thinking “no I don’t want to lose weight” the old rhetoric would find it’s way in- then this is it. Jessamyn is fat and beautiful and so strong and talented you will be desperate to be just like her. It’s very hard to slip into that “I need to lose weight” agenda when your teacher is fat and phenomenal. Why wouldn’t you want to be just like them??

Now I’m getting better I can try other exercise as well like skipping and swimming, things I love but usually end in calorie counting and bad weight maths. And I always know if those feelings start to creep up I go back to Underbelly and reset. 

Really, thank you so much x
